summary_en: World Holdings Co. (special controlling shareholder holding 94.50% voting) to execute squeeze-out via share sale demand under Company Law §179(1)-(2), acquiring all remaining shares from minority shareholders (excluding World's 18,145,111 shares and nms's treasury); nms delisted from TSE Standard 2026-08-28 after 2026-08-27 status as adjustment-listed security.
title_en: Notice regarding World Holdings Co.'s share sale demand against nms Holdings' shares, approval thereof, and delisting of nms Holdings shares
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-30, nms Holdings filed notice of a take-private squeeze-out by World Holdings Co., its parent and special controlling shareholder. World Holdings completed a tender offer for nms shares on 2026-07-17, acquiring 18,145,111 shares (94.50% of voting rights, computed from 21,611,000 issued shares less 2,410,259 treasury shares = 19,200,741 shares outstanding ex-treasury). Having crossed the 90% voting threshold, World Holdings invoked Company Law §179(1)-(2) to demand sale of all remaining nms shares held by minority shareholders (excluding World's own 18,145,111 shares and nms's treasury holdings) to World Holdings, with no purchase price disclosed in this filing. nms's board approved the sale demand on 2026-07-30. As a result, nms shares will be designated an adjustment-listed security from 2026-08-27 and delisted from the TSE Standard market on 2026-08-28, ending public trading.
